dedupe_keys.name: usgs 3d elevation program 3dep lidar and elevation products

description: The 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) is the USGS programme that collects high-quality lidar elevation data for the United States and publishes elevation products derived from it. Lidar is collected to defined quality levels, and products include lidar point clouds, digital elevation models and the Seamless 1-metre DEM (S1M). The programme is run by the USGS; its 3D Nation study found about 13.5 billion dollars in benefits. All 3DEP products are available free and without use restrictions, including through The National Map downloader. Caveats: acquisition dates and quality levels vary by project area, so a mosaic mixes surveys of different years. It provides the terrain base for flood inundation, landslide susceptibility, drainage and corridor planning of roads, rail, pipelines and power lines; a related record is AHN, the Dutch national elevation model.
